instagram.caption:
Not taking your 401(k) match is like turning down a raise 💸

Many employers match part of what you save. With a common 50% match up to 6% of pay, saving $3,600 of a $60,000 salary brings $1,800 from your employer: an instant 50% on that money before any growth. Formulas and vesting rules differ, so check your plan. Education, not financial advice.

Share this with a coworker who has not signed up yet.

Educational only, not financial advice.

#401k #retirement #personalfinance #money #moneytips
